C

The distance in parsecs (pc) is the reciprocal of the parallax angle in arcseconds, so d = 1 / 0.10 = 10 pc. The question requires the answer in SI units (meters). Using the conversion from the IB Physics data booklet, 1 pc ≈ 3.09 × 10^16 m, the distance is 10 pc × (3.09 × 10^16 m/pc) = 3.09 × 10^17 m. This value rounds to 3.1 × 10^17 m, matching option C.

question.html:
A very distant star is measured to have a parallax angle of arcsec.

What is the distance to the star in SI units?

  1. 10 pc
  2. 32.6 ly
